newsitem.title: USA: Delta Air sees aircraft purchase decision soon.
newsitem.headline: Delta Air sees aircraft purchase decision soon.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc said Tuesday it plans to make a "major decision" for aircraft purchases within the next 60 days.
Delta "hopes that some kind of decision would be made in the next 60 days. We expect a major decision in the company within that time frame," said Delta spokesman Bill Berry.
Delta said it was evaluating various models to replace its fleet of L-1011s. At the end of the fiscal year ending June 30, Delta had 38 domestic L-1011s and 17 international L-1011s, Berry said.
Delta said it considering relacing those aircraft with the Airbus Industrie 330, the Boeing Co 777 or the Boeing 767-400.
Delta said it was also considering additional aircraft acquisitions, but declined to comment on the extent of a possible order.
Analysts expect the company to split its aircraft order between Airbus and Boeing.
